newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil spreads mixed, Russian trades easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil spreads mixed, Russian trades easier.

text.p: NWE gas oil spreads were mixed in very thin business on Thursday, traders said.

Outright values rose $3.75 a tonne in line with September IPE, which last traded at $173.75, reflecting stronger U.S. gasoline and a catch-up with Brent's late Wednesday rally. October finished at $175.25.
Two cargoes of Russian gas oil were heard moving at a 50 cent discount and a 25 cent discount to September IPE, traders said, some 25 cents easier.
A German heating oil cargo was also heard moving at around a 75 cent premium to September IPE, unchanged.
Low sulphur diesel cargoes were little changed at around September IPE +$4.50/$5.50 cif NWE.
One cargo was heard placed into Milford Haven but no value was immediately available.
On the barge market, Rotterdam refinery grade low sulphur diesel was bid unchanged around September +$4 with notional offers of around $4.50.
Rotterdam refinery heating oil was called weaker around September IPE -75/50 cents to flat after a couple of early morning trades at September flat fob ARA.
